value.answer: Honda Odyssey, I'd say. U.S. News has it at the top with a 9.3 out of 10, and Car Talk's staff goes with it too. The rankings don't fully agree though. If gas mileage matters most, get the Sienna, which gets 36 mpg combined in front-wheel drive. If you need the most cargo room, the Carnival holds 145.1 cu ft with all seats folded, 44 more than the Sienna.
